author: fihsdbjoke
content:
basic grammar ❤️:

your = belongs to you
you’re = you are

their = belongs to them
they’re = they are
there = a place

two = literally a number. 2.
too = in addition to something, also
to = motion. going to a place. to do something.

where = there
wear = TO PUT SOMETHING ON YOUR BODY. TO WEAR IT. 

four = the number. 4.
for = POSSESSION. para. in support or favor of something. representing something. 
fore = THE FRONT OF SOMETHING

bare = naked, empty, without something
bear = the animal. 

then = past tense. back then. ok then.
than = less than or greater than. used in comparison & contrast. 

lose = to be without something. to have lost it.
loose = wiggly :3, not fixed in place

fair = something that is just and without favoritism. or one of the fun thingies like a carnival . or something that is light. 
fare = like a ticket or sumn. something you pay.

die = ️️ cmon guys be fr now
dye = coloring something (usually hair or food or slime or sumn)

buy = to purchase something 
by = a preposition. identifying a noun following an action. or identifying an author. 
bye = goodbye. you should buy bye bye bye by *nsync.

hope this helps ❤️
